responsibility: Declares the Output module interface for redirectable text emission to either an opened file or a transient in-memory string buffer, including routines for writing characters, strings, NameKey values, line terminators, cardinals, and for starting or ending buffered capture. This header defines a higher-level output abstraction above FIO and SFIO.
same_name_distinction: This is the public interface half of the GOutput pair: it exposes the redirectable output routines and buffer-capture functions, while GOutput.cc contains the destination globals and the concrete logic for writing to files versus in-memory DynamicStrings buffers.
